description: Reviewed decisions for tools/validate-microcopy.mjs. Each entry is a lesson string or an engine string literal that the gate flags but a human read and judged right as written (for example a banned word quoted from a wrong student answer the lesson asks the class to correct). Entry shape: { file, path, rule, reason } where file is the repo path, path is the field path for lesson data or ':<line>' for an engine file, rule is the detector id the gate prints, and reason is 40+ characters. An entry whose finding no longer fires FAILS and must be deleted. Empty on purpose: on 2026-10-27 the 12 generic engine messages, 10 title-case button labels and 6 lesson strings the gate found were fixed (docs/copy-change-log.md, engine/core/copy-dictionary.js) rather than excused. The five 'Not quite - try again' style strings the multiple-choice card DETECTS in authored data live in AUTHORED_BOILERPLATE in copy-dictionary.js, which the gate skips because they are matched, never shown.
